= tool(1)
Jane Doe
v1.0
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Tool Manual
:mansource: Tool 1.0

== Name

tool - does things

== Synopsis

*tool* [_OPTION_]... _FILE_...

== Options

*-v, --verbose*::
  Be verbose.

*-o* _FILE_::
  Write output to _FILE_.

== Example

----
$ tool -v input.txt
----

== Exit Status

*0*:: Success.
*1*:: Failure.
